programme.desc: 'S8/E7 - Bangkok: A Second Bite'. Andrew Zimmern travels to Bangkok to sample some traditional delicious dishes. He digs into steamed whole bass, massaman curry and loads more!

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S8/E8 - Phuket'. Andrew Zimmern explores the alluring traditional dishes of Phuket, Thailand. He samples everything from spicy crab curry to sweet and crispy street snacks.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S8/E9 - Kyoto'. Andrew Zimmern explores the elaborate and unique food feasts of Kyoto, Japan. He samples their traditional multicourse meal known as kaiseki and the comfort food obanzai.

programme.desc: 'S8/E10 - Kanazawa'. Andrew Zimmern explores Kanazawa in Japan. He samples everything from the kano crab to sushi and other tantalising treats that are unspoiled by international tourism.
